reachability: The stage function constructs owner locally, immediately captures frame/stage data, and returns a separate context exposing selected copied fields and closures, not the owner object itself. The supplied read callback receives a path and does not receive that owner reference. Under trusted committed startup there is no supported route in this function exposing the exact owner object whose assertCurrent property the old wrapper dynamically reads. The new alias is therefore equivalent for that actual private object; it intentionally would not follow unsupported property reassignment if such a reference escaped.

The genuine owner composed guard is a zero-argument closure; capturing and calling the same function without its former owner receiver does not alter its semantics. The proposed tuple originates from that actual closure and actual node, while exposing no source reader or projection.
